info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens Historic Decision Executions API

params.name: id
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given id.

params.name: decisionDefinitionId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given definition id.

params.name: deploymentId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given deployment id.

params.name: decisionKey
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given decision key.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given activity id.

params.name: executionId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given execution id.

params.name: instanceId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given instance id.

params.name: scopeType
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given scope type.

params.name: withoutScopeType
params.description: Only return historic decision executions without a scope type.

params.name: processInstanceIdWithChildren
params.description: Return all historic decision executions with the given process instance id or its entity link children.

params.name: caseInstanceIdWithChildren
params.description: Return all historic decision executions with the given case instance id or its entity link children.

params.name: failed
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the failed state.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return historic decision executions with the given tenant id.

params.name: tenantIdLike
params.description: Only return historic decision executions like the given tenant id.

params.name: sort
params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.name: start
params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.
